sections.content: Mutual Group is a fast-growing, entrepreneurial financial services company serving registered investment advisors (RIAs), Registered Representatives, and advisors through the United States, with offices in Camarillo, CA, , Omaha, NE and Little Rock, AR. With over 40 years of experience, we have deep expertise in brokerage, compliance, technology, and operations, and we believe in the power of partnership. Our mission is to transform the lives of our advisor community and power them towards success, enabling them to work smarter, and focus on what they love and do best. We are rooted in our company values – Personal, Authentic, Collaborative, and Knowledgeable – and these are aligned with our vision of being an aspirational B2B leader in our industry and powering a cultural shift towards truly authentic partnerships.

sections.heading: Description:
sections.content: The Director of Compliance will work closely with the Chief Compliance Officer providing service to the Firm’s advisors on all matters of investment-related and broker-dealer activity. This role will operate as a primary point of escalation and interface for our advisors and employees. The responsibilities of the position include but are not limited to ADV updates and filings, development of education and guidance for advisors, registered representatives and employees, deployment of policies and procedures ,  addressing general compliance inquiries from advisors, registered representatives and employees, consultation of compliance best practices and helping to develop compliance personnel.

sections.heading: Responsibilities & Activities:
sections.content:
Filing Firms’ ADV Part 1 and 2, and Form CRS
Updating ADV Part 2s, Form CRS, Privacy Policy and Business Continuity Plan, as necessary
Assist with the development and deployment of new and updated policies and procedures
Assist with the maintenance of broker-dealer compliance program
Assist with the development and deployment of advisor and registered representative education and guidance materials
Help oversee periodic branch exams, including follow-up on audit findings and proactively addressing potential compliance issues
Review ongoing testing and monitoring of services and activity to identify potential areas of risk
Manage regulatory exams and requests as well as other internal reviews and audits
Review and/or prepare various compliance and surveillance reports
Provide consultative guidance to advisors and registered representatives on compliance policies and procedures
Conduct introductory meetings with new advisors and registered representatives to introduce compliance and mitigate risk
Develop and train additional compliance team members to service registered investment advisers and registered representatives
Develop and train advisors, registered representatives and employees on comprehension of various policies, procedures, and systems
Provide consultation for advisors, registered representatives and employees on use of technology for adhering to various policies and procedures
Assist with the ongoing monitoring of 3(21) ERISA plan services

sections.heading: Knowledge, Skills & Abilities Focus:
sections.content:
Undergraduate degree in Business, Finance, or related discipline
7+ years industry experience
Licenses/Certifications Required: Series 7, 24, and 66 (or 65 & 63)
Experience with all Microsoft applications, particularly Excel, Word, and SharePoint.
Knowledge of mutual funds, annuities, general securities, and other financial products required
Ability to work in a fast paced/high volume environment
Strong knowledge of SEC, FINRA, ERISA and state securities rules and regulations
Ability to multi-task, strong attention to detail, excellent problem-solving and follow-up skills
Excellent oral and written communication skills
Ability to make regulatory and supervisory-based decisions
Proactive collaboration and service-based responses with business partners on escalated issues and concerns is essential

sections.heading: Why Join Mutual:
sections.content:
Be part of a company that values personal connections, authenticity, collaboration, and knowledge.
Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package, including health insurance, 401k plan, generous PTO, and wellness initiatives.
Opportunities for continuous learning and professional development in a supportive and dynamic environment.

sections.heading: Application Process:
sections.content: If you meet the qualifications and are ready to take on this exciting challenge, we invite you to submit your resume and cover letter detailing your experience and how it aligns with the responsibilities and qualifications of this role.
Join us in powering the success of advisors and transforming the financial services landscape.
